examples.pinyin: Jīngguò sān nián de nǔlì, wǒmen zh终于 qǔdé le xiǎnzhù de chéngguǒ.
examples.english: After three years of effort, we finally achieved remarkable results.

examples.chinese: 他通过努力学习取得了很大的成就。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōngguò nǔlì xuéxí qǔdéle hěn dà de chéngjiù.
examples.english: He achieved great success through hard work and studying.

examples.chinese: 这些苹果已经成熟了，可以吃了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ yǐjīng chéngshú le, kěyǐ chī le.
examples.english: These apples are ripe now and ready to eat.

examples.chinese: 我们的公司去年成立了一个新的部门。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de gōngsī qùnián chénglì le yīgè xīn de bùmén.
examples.english: Our company established a new department last year.

examples.chinese: 我们足球队的每个成员都很努力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zúqiú duì de měi ge chéngyuán dōu hěn nǔlì.
examples.english: Every member of our soccer team works very hard.

examples.chinese: 我在这个学校里成长了很多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhège xuéxiào lǐ chéngzhǎng le hěn duō.
examples.english: I have grown a lot at this school.

examples.chinese: 我们去年去了西安城墙，风景很美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qùnián qù le Xī'ān chéngqiáng, fēngjǐng hěn měi.
examples.english: We visited the Xi'an city wall last year, and the scenery was very beautiful.

examples.chinese: 我喜欢住在城市里，因为那里有很多有趣的事情。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhù zài chéngshì lǐ, yīnwèi nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō yǒuqù de shìqing.
examples.english: I like living in the city because there are many interesting things to do there.

examples.chinese: 这个项目持续了三个月才完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù chíxù le sān ge yuè cái wánchéng.
examples.english: This project lasted three months before it was completed.

examples.chinese: 这个问题的程度有点难，但我们可以一起解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de chéngdù yǒudiǎn nán, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ jiějué.
examples.english: This problem is somewhat difficult in terms of difficulty level, but we can solve it together.

examples.chinese: 初中的时候，我最喜欢和朋友们一起玩。
examples.pinyin: Chūzhōng de shíhou, wǒ zuì xǐhuān hé péngyoumen yìqǐ wán.
examples.english: In junior high school, I loved playing with my friends the most.

examples.chinese: 这个教室充满了学生的笑声。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàoshì chōngmǎn le xuésheng de xiàoshēng.
examples.english: This classroom is filled with the laughter of students.

examples.chinese: 我初步了解了这个项目的情况。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chūbù liǎojiěle zhège xiàngmù de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: I have an initial understanding of this project's situation.

examples.chinese: 我现在还在初级班学习英语。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài háishi zài chūjí bān xuéxí yīngyǔ.
examples.english: I'm still studying English in the junior class right now.

examples.chinese: 这个箱子很重，我一个人搬不动。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi hěn zhòng, wǒ yīgè rén bān bu dòng.
examples.english: This suitcase is very heavy; I can't move it by myself.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟今年上初中了，他很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi jīnnián shàng chūzhōng le, tā hěn gāoxìng.
examples.english: My younger brother started junior high school this year, and he is very happy.

examples.chinese: 除了周末，我每天都要上班。
examples.pinyin: Chúle zhōumò, wǒ měitiān dōu yào shàngbān.
examples.english: Except for weekends, I have to work every day.

examples.chinese: 这个问题很复杂，我需要时间来处理。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn fùzá, wǒ xūyào shíjiān lái chǔlǐ.
examples.english: This problem is complicated, and I need time to handle it.

examples.chinese: 请把这个消息传给你的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhège xiāoxī chuán gěi nǐ de péngyou.
examples.english: Please pass this message to your friend.

examples.chinese: 互联网可以快速传播信息。
examples.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng kěyǐ kuàisù chuánbō xìnxī.
examples.english: The internet can disseminate information quickly.

examples.chinese: 传说这座山里有一只老虎，但是没人见过。
examples.pinyin: Chuánshuō zhè zuò shān lǐ yǒu yī zhī lǎohǔ, dànshì méi rén jiàn guò.
examples.english: Legend has it that there is a tiger in this mountain, but no one has ever seen it.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为创新而成功了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi chuàngxīn ér chénggōng le.
examples.english: This company succeeded because of innovation.

examples.chinese: 艺术家用颜色创造了一个美丽的世界。
examples.pinyin: Yìshùjiā yòng颜sè chuàngzào le yīgè měilì de shìjiè.
examples.english: The artist created a beautiful world with colors.

examples.chinese: 楼下传来了音乐声，很好听。
examples.pinyin: lóuxià chuánláile yīnyuè shēng, hěn hǎotīng.
examples.english: Music sounds came from downstairs, and they sounded very nice.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家的创作灵感来自于大自然。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā de chuàngzuò língǎn láizìyú dà zìránjiè.
examples.english: This artist's creative inspiration comes from nature.

examples.chinese: 他辞掉工作去创业，现在经营一家小餐馆。
examples.pinyin: Tā cídiào gōngzuò qù chuàngyè, xiànzài jīngyíng yī jiā xiǎo cānguǎn.
examples.english: He quit his job to start a business, and now he runs a small restaurant.

examples.chinese: 从前我不喜欢吃蔬菜，现在我很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Cóngqián wǒ búxǐhuān chī shūcài, xiànzài wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Previously I didn't like eating vegetables, but now I really enjoy them.

examples.chinese: 我从来没有去过北京。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méiyǒu qùguò Běijīng.
examples.english: I have never been to Beijing.

examples.chinese: 我的父亲从事教育工作已经有二十年了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fùqīn cóngshì jiàoyù gōngzuò yǐjīng yǒu èrshí nián le.
examples.english: My father has been engaged in educational work for twenty years.

examples.chinese: 我心里一直存着对家乡的思念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīnlǐ yīzhí cúnzhe duì jiāxiāng de sīniàn.
examples.english: I have always harbored nostalgia for my hometown in my heart.

examples.chinese: 我的奶奶住在一个很小的村子里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǎinai zhù zài yīgè hěn xiǎo de cūnzi lǐ.
examples.english: My grandmother lives in a very small village.

examples.chinese: 这个问题存在已经很久了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí cúnzài yǐjīng hěn jiǔ le.
examples.english: This problem has existed for a very long time.

examples.chinese: 我写错了一个字，这是一个很小的错误。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiě cuò le yī gè zì, zhè shì yī gè hěn xiǎo de cuòwù.
examples.english: I wrote one character wrong; this is a very small error.

examples.chinese: 今年公司的销售额达到了一百万元。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián gōngsī de xiāoshòu'é dádào le yībǎi wàn yuán.
examples.english: This year, the company's sales reached one million yuan.

examples.chinese: 他在寒风中打破了衣服，冷得一直打哆嗦。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài háinfēng zhōng dǎpò le yīfu, lěng de yīzhí dǎ duōsuo.
examples.english: He tore his clothes in the cold wind and shivered the whole time because of the cold.

examples.chinese: 今天大概要下雨，你最好带伞。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dàgài yào xiàyǔ, nǐ zuìhǎo dài sǎn.
examples.english: It will probably rain today, so you'd better bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 我打听了一下，这家餐厅的菜很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎtīngle yīxià, zhè jiā cāntīng de cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I asked around a bit, and the food at this restaurant is very delicious.

examples.chinese: 我需要去美国大使馆申请签证。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào qù Měiguó dàshǐguǎn shēnqǐng qiānzhèng.
examples.english: I need to go to the American embassy to apply for a visa.

examples.chinese: 这部电影大约两个小时，我们现在去看还来得及。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng dàyuē liǎng ge xiǎoshí, wǒmen xiànzài qù kàn háilái de jí.
examples.english: This movie is about two hours long, we can still make it if we go now.

examples.chinese: 在现代，很多人喜欢用手机。
examples.pinyin: Zài xiàndài, hěnduō rén xǐhuān yòng shǒujī.
examples.english: In modern times, many people like to use mobile phones.

examples.chinese: 他是我们班的代表，要去参加学校的比赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen bān de dàibiǎo, yào qù参加 xuéxiào de bǐsài.
examples.english: He is the representative of our class and will go to participate in the school competition.

english: a senior official in feudal China

examples.chinese: 在古代，大夫是皇帝身边的重要官员。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàfū shì huáng帝 shēnbiān de zhòngyào guānyuán.
examples.english: In ancient times, a dàfu was an important official close to the emperor.

examples.chinese: 中国代表团在奥运会上表现得非常好。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó dàibiǎotuán zài Àoyùnhuì shang biǎoxiàn de fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: The Chinese contingent performed very well at the Olympics.

examples.chinese: 这个成功的例子带动了很多年轻人去创业。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chénggōng de lìzi dàidòng le hěnduō niánqīngrén qù chuàngyè.
examples.english: This successful example drove many young people to start their own businesses.

examples.chinese: 这个数学单元很重要，你要认真学习。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shùxué dānyuán hěn zhòngyào, nǐ yào rènzhēn xuéxí.
examples.english: This math module is very important, so you need to study it seriously.

examples.chinese: 当初我们刚认识的时候，都不知道会成为好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Dāngchū wǒmen gāng rènshi de shíhou, dōu búzhīdào huì chéngwéi hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: At that time when we first met, neither of us knew we would become good friends.

examples.chinese: 这位老师带领我们去参观了博物馆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎoshī dàilǐng wǒmen qù cānguān le bówùguǎn.
examples.english: This teacher led us to visit the museum.

examples.chinese: 你想去看电影吗？当然想去！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng ma? Dāngrán xiǎng qù!
examples.english: Do you want to go see a movie? Of course I do!

examples.chinese: 我去年去了云南，当地的食物非常好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qùle Yúnnán, dāngdì de shíwù fēicháng hǎochī.
examples.english: I went to Yunnan last year, and the local food was extremely delicious.

examples.chinese: 在这些学生当中，小王的成绩最好。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhèxiē xuésheng dāngzhōng, Xiǎo Wáng de chéngjì zuì hǎo.
examples.english: Among these students, Xiaowang has the best grades.

examples.chinese: 我用刀切面包的时候要小心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng dāo qiē miànbāo de shíhou yào xiǎoxin.
examples.english: I need to be careful when using a knife to cut bread.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的导演是一位很有名的艺术家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de dǎoyǎn shì yī wèi hěn yǒumíng de yìshùjiā.
examples.english: The director of this film is a very famous artist.

examples.chinese: 我们明天早上到达北京。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang dàodá Běijīng.
examples.english: We will arrive in Beijing tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 他在比赛中得分最高，赢了比赛。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng défēn zuì gāo, yíngle bǐsài.
examples.english: He scored the highest in the competition and won the match.

examples.chinese: 你到底想吃什么？我们已经问了很多次了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Wǒmen yǐjīng wènle hěnduō cì le.
examples.english: What do you really want to eat? We've asked you many times already.

examples.chinese: 我在车站等待我的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn děngdài wǒ de péngyou.
examples.english: I am waiting for my friend at the bus station.

examples.chinese: 桌子底下有一只猫在睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi dǐxia yǒu yī zhī māo zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: There is a cat sleeping under the table.

examples.chinese: 我们公司在南方地区有很多分店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài nánfāng dìqū yǒu hěnduō fēn店。
examples.english: Our company has many branches in the southern region.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸在电视台工作，他是一个记者。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba zài diànshìtái gōngzuò, tā shì yīgè jìzhě.
examples.english: My father works at a television station, and he is a journalist.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸喜欢在开车的时候听电台。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xǐhuān zài kāichē de shíhou tīng diàntái.
examples.english: My dad likes to listen to the radio while driving.

examples.chinese: 请把你的电子邮件地址发给我。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de diànzǐyóujiàn dìzhǐ fā gěi wǒ.
examples.english: Please send me your email address.

examples.chinese: 公司把我调到了北京分公司工作。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī bǎ wǒ diàodàole běijīng fēngōngsī gōngzuò.
examples.english: The company transferred me to work at the Beijing branch.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上看了一部很有趣的电视剧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang kàn le yī bù hěn yǒuqù de diànshìjù.
examples.english: I watched a very interesting TV play last night.

examples.chinese: 警察正在调查这起事故。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài diàochá zhè qǐ shìgù.
examples.english: The police are investigating this accident.

examples.chinese: 我想订一份报纸，每天都能读到新闻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dìng yī fèn bàozhǐ, měi tiān dōu néng dú dào xīnwén.
examples.english: I want to subscribe to a newspaper so I can read the news every day.

examples.chinese: 我每个月都要定期去医院检查身体。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè dōu yào dìngqī qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá shēntǐ.
examples.english: I have to go to the hospital for regular check-ups every month.

examples.chinese: 我的家在中国东部，靠近大海。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de jiā zài Zhōngguó dōngbù,靠近 dàhǎi.
examples.english: My home is in the eastern part of China, close to the sea.

examples.chinese: 这个故事很动人，让我哭了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshì hěn dòngrén, ràng wǒ哭le.
examples.english: This story is very moving, it made me cry.

examples.chinese: 这本书的读者主要是年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de dúzhě zhǔyào shì niánqīng rén.
examples.english: The readers of this book are mainly young people.

examples.chinese: 学习新技能给了我很大的动力。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí xīn jìnéng gěile wǒ hěn dà de dònglì.
examples.english: Learning new skills gave me a lot of driving force.

examples.chinese: 夏天天气很热，我喜欢穿短裤。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān tiānqì hěn rè, wǒ xǐhuān chuān duǎnkù.
examples.english: In summer the weather is very hot, and I like to wear short pants.

examples.chinese: 每个人都有优点和短处，重要的是不断改进自己。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu yōudiǎn hé duǎnchù, zhònyào de shì búduàn gǎijìn zìjǐ.
examples.english: Everyone has strengths and shortcomings; what's important is to constantly improve yourself.

examples.chinese: 他决定断了和那个朋友的联系。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédinɡ duànle hé nàɡe penyou de liánxì.
examples.english: He decided to break off contact with that friend.

examples.chinese: 这个短期课程只需要学习两个月。
examples.pinyin: Zhège duǎnqī kèchéng zhǐ xūyào xuéxí liǎng ge yuè.
examples.english: This short-term course only requires two months of study.

examples.chinese: 我们队员都很努力，想要赢得这场比赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen duìyuán dōu hěn nǔlì, xiǎngyào yíngde zhè chǎng bǐsài.
examples.english: All of our team members are working hard because we want to win this game.

examples.chinese: 老师对待每个学生都很公平。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī duìdài měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn gōngpíng.
examples.english: The teacher treats every student fairly.

examples.chinese: 我不同意对方的意见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búsuǒyì duìfāng de yìjiàn.
examples.english: I disagree with the other party's opinion.

examples.chinese: 她的对象是一个很有趣的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de duìxiàng shì yīgè hěn yǒuqù de rén.
examples.english: Her boyfriend is a very interesting person.

examples.chinese: 他的对手是一个很强的选手。
examples.pinyin: Tā de duìshǒu shì yī ge hěn qiáng de xuǎnshǒu.
examples.english: His opponent is a very strong player.

examples.chinese: 他在会议上发表了自己的意见。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài huìyì shang fābiǎole zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: He voiced his opinion at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 他突然停顿了一下，然后继续说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā túrán tíngdùn le yīxià, ránhòu jìxù shuōhuà.
examples.english: He suddenly paused for a moment, then continued speaking.

examples.chinese: 婴儿发出了响亮的哭声。
examples.pinyin: Yīng'ér fā chūle xiǎngliàng de kūshēng.
examples.english: The baby let out a loud cry.

examples.chinese: 日本是一个很发达的国家。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn shì yī gè hěn fādá de guójiā.
examples.english: Japan is a very developed country.

examples.chinese: 我们明天发动一个新的项目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān fādòng yī gè xīn de xiàngmù.
examples.english: We will start a new project tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 电灯是一个伟大的发明。
examples.pinyin: Diàndēng shì yīgè wěidà de fāmíng.
examples.english: The electric light is a great invention.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上发生了一个有趣的事情。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang fāshēngle yīgè yǒuqù de shìqing.
examples.english: Something interesting happened last night.

examples.chinese: 请你把这个文件发送给我。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhège wénjiàn fāsong gěi wǒ.
examples.english: Please send this file to me.

examples.chinese: 在会议上，经理要求每个人都发言。
examples.pinyin: Zài huìyì shang, jīnglǐ yāoqiú měi gè rén dōu fāyán.
examples.english: At the meeting, the manager required everyone to speak.

examples.chinese: 我们的公司在过去两年里发展得很快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de gōngsī zài guòqù liǎng nián lǐ fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
examples.english: Our company has developed very quickly over the past two years.

examples.chinese: 我反复检查了我的作业，确保没有错误。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fǎnfù jiǎnchá le wǒ de zuòyè, quèbǎo méiyǒu cuòwù.
examples.english: I repeatedly checked my homework to make sure there were no mistakes.

examples.chinese: 他听到这个消息的反应很快。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī de fǎnyìng hěn kuài.
examples.english: His reaction to hearing this news was very quick.

examples.english: This bottle of milk is one litre.

examples.chinese: 老师用生动的故事吸引了所有学生的注意力。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòng shēngdòng de gùshì xīyǐnle suǒyǒu xuésheng de zhùyìlì.
examples.english: The teacher attracted all the students' attention with a lively story.

examples.chinese: 每个人的生命都很珍贵。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén de shēngmìng dōu hěn zhēnguì.
examples.english: Every person's life is very precious.

examples.chinese: 他的生意最近做得很好，赚了不少钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngyi zuìjìn zuò de hěn hǎo, zuàn le búshǎo qián.
examples.english: His business has been doing very well recently, and he has made quite a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 这棵树在阳光下生长得很快。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē shù zài yángguāng xià shēngzhǎng de hěn kuài.
examples.english: This tree grows very quickly in the sunlight.

examples.chinese: 公司今天发表了一份重要声明。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīntiān fābiǎole yī fèn zhòngyào shēngmíng.
examples.english: The company released an important statement today.

examples.chinese: 我们的队伍在比赛中胜了对手。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de duìwu zài bǐsài zhōng shèngle duìshǒu.
examples.english: Our team defeated the opponent in the competition.

examples.chinese: 我们的足球队今天赢得了胜利。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de zúqiú duì jīntiān yíngde le shènglì.
examples.english: Our football team won a victory today.

examples.chinese: 这条路很不好走，到处都是石头。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn búhǎo zǒu, dàochù dōu shì shítou.
examples.english: This road is very difficult to walk on; there are stones everywhere.

examples.chinese: 这个国家的石油储量很丰富。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de shíyóu chǔliàng hěn fēngfù.
examples.english: This country has abundant crude oil reserves.

examples.chinese: 我每次到北京的时候，都会去长城玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì dào Běijīng de shíhou, dōu huì qù Chángchéng wán.
examples.english: Every time I go to Beijing, I always visit the Great Wall.

examples.chinese: 我不想失去这个好机会，所以我决定参加这个比赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búxiǎng shīqù zhège hǎo jīhuì, suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng cānjiā zhège bǐsài.
examples.english: I don't want to lose this good opportunity, so I decided to participate in this competition.

examples.chinese: 我们生活在一个很好的时代。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shēnghuó zài yīgè hěn hǎo de shídài.
examples.english: We live in a great age.

examples.chinese: 这个项目看起来很简单，但实际上需要花很多时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù kànqǐlái hěn jiǎndān, dàn shíjìshang xūyào huā hěnduō shíjiān.
examples.english: This project looks simple, but in fact it requires a lot of time.

examples.chinese: 公司决定从下个月开始实行新的工作制度。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng cóng xiàge yuè kāishǐ shíxíng xīn de gōngzuò zhìdù.
examples.english: The company decided to implement a new work system starting next month.

examples.chinese: 这个公司的实力很强，产品质量特别好。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī de shílì hěn qiáng, chǎnpǐn zhìliàng tèbié hǎo.
examples.english: This company has strong strength/capability, and its product quality is especially good.

examples.chinese: 我每时刻都在想你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi shíkè dōu zài xiǎng nǐ.
examples.english: I think of you every moment.

examples.chinese: 我们的化学实验室在学校的第二栋楼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de huàxué shíyànshì zài xuéxiào de dì èr dòng lóu.
examples.english: Our chemistry lab is in the second building of the school.

examples.chinese: 我们今天在实验室做了一个有趣的实验。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān zài shíyànshì zuòle yīgè yǒuqù de shíyàn.
examples.english: We did an interesting experiment in the laboratory today.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的食品很新鲜，我很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting de shípǐn hěn xīnxiān, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: The food at this restaurant is very fresh, and I really like it.

examples.chinese: 他始终坚持每天早上跑步，从不间断。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǐzhōng jiānchí měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù, cóng bù jiànduàn.
examples.english: He consistently insists on running every morning without ever stopping.

examples.chinese: 这个政策使空气变得更加清新了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngcè shǐ kōngqì biàn de gèngjiā qīngxīn le.
examples.english: This policy made the air become much fresher.

examples.chinese: 二十一世纪是一个很重要的时代。
examples.pinyin: Èrshíyī shìjì shì yīgè hěn zhòngyào de shídài.
examples.english: The twenty-first century is a very important era.

examples.chinese: 我想看看外面的世界。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kànkan wàimiàn de shìjiè.
examples.english: I want to see what the world outside is like.

examples.chinese: 周末我喜欢去菜市场买新鲜的蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān qù cài shìchǎng mǎi xīnxiān de shūcài.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to go to the vegetable market to buy fresh vegetables.

examples.chinese: 我很喜欢看世界杯足球赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn shìjiècbēi zúqiú sài.
examples.english: I really like watching the World Cup football match.

examples.chinese: 昨天发生了一起交通事故，所以我迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān fāshēngle yī qǐ jiāotōng shìgù, suǒyǐ wǒ chídào le.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident yesterday, so I was late.

examples.chinese: 昨天发生了一个很有趣的事件，我的朋友赢得了比赛。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān fāshēngle yī ge hěn yǒuqù de shìjiàn, wǒ de péngyou yíngdéle bǐsài.
examples.english: An interesting event happened yesterday - my friend won the competition.

examples.chinese: 事实上，他昨天没有来上课。
examples.pinyin: Shìshí shang, tā zuótiān méiyǒu lái shàngkè.
examples.english: In fact, he didn't come to class yesterday.

examples.chinese: 事实上，我觉得这个电影不太好看。
examples.pinyin: Shìshíshang, wǒ juéde zhège diànyǐng búduō hǎokàn.
examples.english: In fact, I don't think this movie is very good.

examples.chinese: 他的事业很成功，现在管理一家大公司。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shìyè hěn chénggōng, xiànzài guǎnlǐ yī jiā dà gōngsī.
examples.english: His career is very successful; he now manages a large company.

examples.chinese: 这个新产品需要先做试验，确保安全以后才能上市。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn chǎnpǐn xūyào xiān zuò shìyàn, quèbǎo ānquán yǐhòu cái néng shàngshì.
examples.english: This new product needs to be tested first to ensure safety before it can be released to the market.

examples.chinese: 这道试题太难了，我不会做。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào shìtí tài nán le, wǒ bù huì zuò.
examples.english: This exam question is too difficult. I don't know how to do it.

examples.chinese: 这件衣服很适合你，颜色对你很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn shìhé nǐ, yánsè duì nǐ hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: This piece of clothing suits you well; the color looks very good on you.

examples.chinese: 这个规则适用于所有学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guīzé shìyòng yú suǒyǒu xuésheng.
examples.english: This rule applies to all students.

examples.chinese: 我用了一个月才适应了新的工作环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòngle yī ge yuè cái shìyìngle xīn de gōngzuò huánjìng.
examples.english: It took me a month to get accustomed to the new work environment.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅不收费，你可以免费吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bù shōu fèi, nǐ kěyǐ miǎnfèi chīfàn.
examples.english: This restaurant doesn't charge fees; you can eat for free.

examples.chinese: 我每天晚上都收看新闻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu shōukàn xīnwén.
examples.english: I watch the news every evening.

examples.chinese: 室先生是我的数学老师。
examples.pinyin: Shì xiānsheng shì wǒ de shùxué lǎoshī.
examples.english: Mr. Shi is my math teacher.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上都收听英语广播来学习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang dōu shōutīng yīngyǔ guǎngbō lái xuéxí.
examples.english: I listen to English radio broadcasts every morning to study.

examples.chinese: 办理这个账户需要什么手续吗？
examples.pinyin: Bànlǐ zhège zhànghu xūyào shénme shǒuxù ma?
examples.english: What formalities are needed to open this account?

examples.chinese: 我奶奶每天早上都喜欢听收音机。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai měi tiān zǎoshang dōu xǐhuān tīng shōuyīnjī.
examples.english: My grandmother likes to listen to the radio every morning.

examples.chinese: 北京是中国的首都，那里有很多著名的景点。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng shì Zhōngguó de shǒudū, nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō zhùmíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: Beijing is the capital of China, and there are many famous attractions there.

examples.chinese: 我的手指被门夹住了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒuzhǐ bèi mén jiā zhù le.
examples.english: My finger got pinched by the door.

examples.chinese: 首先，我们需要完成这个项目，然后才能休息。
examples.pinyin: Shǒuxiān, wǒmen xūyào wánchéng zhège xiàngmù, ránhòu cáinéng xiūxi.
examples.english: First of all, we need to complete this project, and then we can rest.

examples.chinese: 他在足球比赛中受伤了，现在还在医院里。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zúqiú bǐsài zhōng shòushāngle, xiànzài háishi zài yīyuàn lǐ.
examples.english: He got injured during the soccer match and is still in the hospital now.

examples.chinese: 这部电影受到了很多人的喜爱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shòudào le hěnduō rén de xǐ'ài.
examples.english: This movie is loved by many people.

examples.chinese: 昨天的比赛我们输了，但我们下次会赢。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de bǐsài wǒmen shū le, dàn wǒmen xiàcì huì yíng.
examples.english: We lost the match yesterday, but we'll win next time.

examples.chinese: 我的房间里有一个大书架，上面放着很多书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān lǐ yǒu yī ge dà shūjià, shàngmiàn fàngzhe hěnduō shū.
examples.english: There is a large bookshelf in my room with many books on it.

examples.chinese: 我在咖啡馆遇到了一个熟人，我们聊了很久。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài kāfēiguǎn yùdàole yīgè shúrén, wǒmen liáole hěnjiǔ.
examples.english: I ran into an acquaintance at the coffee shop, and we chatted for a long time.

examples.chinese: 请输入你的密码。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng shūrù nǐ de mìmǎ.
examples.english: Please enter your password.

examples.chinese: 这个公司属于我的父亲。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngsī shǔyú wǒ de fùqin.
examples.english: This company belongs to my father.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友叫束涛，他是一个很聪明的工程师。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou jiào Shù Tāo, tā shì yīgè hěn聪明 de gōngchéngshī.
examples.english: My friend is named Shu Tao, and he is a very intelligent engineer.

examples.chinese: 这个问题属于我们公司的工作范围。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí shǔyú wǒmen gōngsī de gōngzuò fànwéi.
examples.english: This issue falls under our company's scope of work.

examples.chinese: 这个合作项目对双方都很有好处。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hézuò xiàngmù duì shuāngfāng dōu hěn yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: This cooperation project is beneficial to both sides.

examples.chinese: 这家店的商品数量很多，我们有很多选择。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de shāngpǐn shùliàng hěn duō, wǒmen yǒu hěn duō xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This store has a large quantity of goods, and we have many choices.

examples.chinese: 他的思想很开放，总是愿意尝试新的东西。
examples.pinyin: Tā de sīxiǎng hěn kāifàng, zǒngshì yuànyì chǎngshì xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: His thinking is very open-minded, and he is always willing to try new things.

examples.chinese: 我买了一双新鞋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng xīn xié.
examples.english: I bought a pair of new shoes.

examples.chinese: 那只小鸟死了，我们很难过。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī xiǎo niǎo sǐle, wǒmen hěn nánguò.
examples.english: That little bird died, and we were very sad.

examples.chinese: 这辆车的速度很快，我有点害怕。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de sùdù hěn kuài, wǒ yǒudiǎn hàipà.
examples.english: This car's speed is very fast, and I'm a bit scared.

examples.chinese: 他吃完饭随后就去了公司。
examples.pinyin: Tā chīwán fàn suíhòu jiù qùle gōngsī.
examples.english: After he finished eating, he went to the company right after.

examples.chinese: 这是我所喜欢的电影。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ suǒ xǐhuān de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This is the movie that I like.

examples.chinese: 我来自台湾，那是一个很美的地方。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái zì Táiwān, nàshì yīgè hěn měi de dìfang.
examples.english: I'm from Taiwan, which is a very beautiful place.

examples.chinese: 这位所长在研究所工作了二十年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi suǒcháng zài yánjiūsuǒ gōngzuòle èrshí nián.
examples.english: This institute director has worked at the research institute for twenty years.

examples.chinese: 两个公司正在谈判一个新的合作项目。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge gōngsī zhèngzài tánpàn yī ge xīn de hézuò xiàngmù.
examples.english: The two companies are currently negotiating a new cooperation project.

examples.chinese: 昨天我和老师谈话了，他给了我一些学习的建议。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé lǎoshī tánhuà le, tā gěi le wǒ yīxiē xuéxí de jiànyì.
examples.english: Yesterday I had a talk with my teacher, and he gave me some study advice.

examples.chinese: 我们一起谈论了这个有趣的话题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ tánlùn le zhège yǒuqù de huàtí.
examples.english: We discussed this interesting topic together.

examples.chinese: 妈妈在厨房里煮了一碗热汤。
examples.pinyin: Māmā zài chúfáng lǐ zhǔle yī wǎn rè tāng.
examples.english: Mom made a bowl of hot soup in the kitchen.

examples.chinese: 这个蛋糕里面有很多糖，吃起来很甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàngāo lǐmiàn yǒu hěnduō táng, chīqǐlai hěn tián.
examples.english: There's a lot of sugar in this cake, and it tastes very sweet.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的特色菜是红烧肉，很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de tèsè cài shì hóngshāo ròu, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: This restaurant's signature dish is braised pork belly, which is very popular.

examples.chinese: 课堂上有很多学生提问老师关于这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Kètáng shang yǒu hěnduō xuésheng tíwèn lǎoshī guānyú zhège wèntí.
examples.english: Many students in class questioned the teacher about this problem.

examples.chinese: 我们决定提前一个小时出发去机场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen juédìng tíqián yī ge xiǎoshí chūfā qù jīchǎng.
examples.english: We decided to leave for the airport an hour earlier.

examples.chinese: 通过这次旅行，我深深体会到了家人的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Tōngguò zhè cì lǚxíng, wǒ shēnshēn tǐhuì dàole jiārén de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: Through this trip, I deeply experienced/learned how important family is.

examples.chinese: 这部电影很好地体现了中国文化的魅力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn hǎo de tǐxiàn le Zhōngguó wénhuà de mèilì.
examples.english: This movie embodies the charm of Chinese culture very well.

examples.chinese: 这次考试的题目很难，我做了两个小时才做完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de tímù hěn nán, wǒ zuòle liǎng ge xiǎoshí cái zuò wán.
examples.english: The exam questions this time were very difficult, and it took me two hours to finish them.

examples.chinese: 我去年暑假在农村体验了两个月的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián shǔjiǎ zài nóngcūn tǐyànyàle liǎng ge yuè de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Last summer vacation, I experienced two months of rural life.

examples.chinese: 今天天空很蓝，我们一起去公园玩吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānkōng hěn lán, wǒmen yīqǐ qù gōngyuán wán ba.
examples.english: The sky is very blue today. Let's go to the park together.

examples.chinese: 这个蛋糕很甜，我很喜欢吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàngāo hěn tián, wǒ hěn xǐhuān chī.
examples.english: This cake is very sweet, and I really like eating it.

examples.chinese: 子弹跳过了墙壁，飞向远处。
examples.pinyin: Zǐdàn tiàoguò le qiángbì, fēi xiàng yuǎnchù.
examples.english: The bullet ricocheted off the wall and flew into the distance.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友很擅长跳高，他在学校运动会上赢得了金牌。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou hěn shàncháng tiàogāo, tā zài xuéxiào yùndònghuì shang yíngdéle jīnpái.
examples.english: My friend is very good at high jump, and he won a gold medal at the school sports meet.

examples.chinese: 他在学校运动会上参加了跳远比赛，跳得很远。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào yùndònghuì shang cānjiāle tiàoyuǎn bǐsài, tiàode hěn yuǎn.
examples.english: He participated in the long jump competition at the school sports meet and jumped very far.

examples.chinese: 这个座位不舒服，我需要调整一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zuòwèi búshūfu, wǒ xūyào tiáozhěng yīxià.
examples.english: This seat is uncomfortable, I need to adjust it a bit.

examples.chinese: 爷爷用铁在花园里挖土。
examples.pinyin: Yéyeye yòng tiě zài huāyuán lǐ wā tǔ.
examples.english: Grandfather uses a shovel to dig soil in the garden.

examples.chinese: 周末我喜欢和朋友一起去跳舞。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuān hé péngyou yìqǐ qù tiào wǔ.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to go dancing with friends.

examples.chinese: 这个音乐会的听众很多，票都卖完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yīnyuèhuì de tīngzhòng hěn duō, piào dōu mài wán le.
examples.english: There are many listeners at this concert, and all the tickets have been sold out.

examples.chinese: 我的听力不太好，所以我喜欢看电影的时候打开字幕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tīnglì búcì hǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ xǐhuān kàn diànyǐng de shíhou dǎkāi zìmù.
examples.english: My hearing is not very good, so I like to turn on subtitles when watching movies.

examples.chinese: 我通常早上七点起床去上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng qù shàngbān.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven in the morning to go to work.

examples.chinese: 我们经常通过邮件通信，分享彼此的生活。
